recognize_zh: 單一視野的周邊血中就有六顆以上嗜酸性球，細胞質充滿橘紅色顆粒、核多為雙葉或多葉，部分顆粒分布不均；嗜酸性球明顯增多是懷疑高嗜酸性球症候群（HES）的起點，但形態無法區分反應性或克隆性。
features: Marked eosinophilia with at least six eosinophils in a single field
Mature eosinophils with bilobed to multilobed nuclei
Orange-red cytoplasmic granules, with some cells showing uneven or partially reduced granulation
Occasional small lymphocyte; no blasts identified
Crowded, overlapping red cells without significant poikilocytosis
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a marked increase in eosinophils, most of which are mature with bilobed to multilobed nuclei and orange-red granules; a few show uneven or partially reduced granulation. An occasional small lymphocyte is present and no blasts or immature myeloid cells are seen. Red cells are unremarkable apart from overlapping in a thick area. Findings are consistent with eosinophilia; a diagnosis of idiopathic hypereosinophilic syndrome requires persistent eosinophilia (≥1.5 × 10^9/L) with organ damage after exclusion of reactive causes, clonal myeloid/lymphoid neoplasms with PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2 rearrangements, and lymphocytic variant HES.

ddx.vs: Morphologically identical mature eosinophils; distinguished by history, stool/serology testing and resolution after treating the cause.
May show similar eosinophils with increased mast cells; FIP1L1::PDGFRA detection by FISH or RT-PCR separates it.
Requires clonality or increased blasts (>2% PB or 5-19% BM) with dysplasia, not evident in this field.
Driven by aberrant cytokine-producing T cells (e.g., CD3-CD4+) demonstrable by flow cytometry and TCR clonality.
